# IIEC — Incubation, Innovation & Entrepreneurship Cell

> Where Vision Drives Venture

IIEC (Incubation, Innovation & Entrepreneurship Cell) is the official entrepreneurship cell of Chhatrapati Shivaji Maharaj University (CSMU), located in Navi Mumbai, Maharashtra, India. Founded in December 2024, it is a student-led organization that fosters entrepreneurship, innovation, and startup culture on campus through hackathons, tech fests, workshops, startup bootcamps, mentorship programs, industry connect sessions, and national-level competitions. IIEC ranked Top 23 out of 4,000+ teams across India at the National Entrepreneurship Challenge (NEC), organized by E-Cell IIT Bombay, making it one of the best entrepreneurship cells in Maharashtra. The cell bridges the gap between ideas and execution, helping students build real startups from campus.

## Mission

To ignite the entrepreneurial spirit in every student at CSMU through hands-on startup experiences, real-world industry exposure, and a community that transforms ideas into ventures.

**Mission Pillars:**
- Foster innovation and design thinking among students
- Compete at and prepare students for NEC IIT Bombay and other national competitions
- Connect students with angel investors, mentors, and industry professionals
- Serve as a launchpad for student startups from CSMU campus

---

## Vision

To become India's most recognized college entrepreneurship cell, known for producing successful student founders, award-winning teams, and building a self-sustaining innovation ecosystem at CSMU, Navi Mumbai.

**Vision Goals:**
- Build a thriving community of student entrepreneurs and innovators
- Incubate and launch startups directly from CSMU campus
- Consistently compete and win at national-level entrepreneurship competitions
- Establish venture capital and industry partnerships for student founders

---

## Core Values

1. **Innovation First**: Embracing design thinking and lean startup methodology to solve real problems with creative, scalable solutions.
2. **Community Driven**: Building a culture of peer learning, collaboration, and a supportive student founder network where every member grows together.
3. **Action Oriented**: Moving beyond theory through hackathons, real project building, startup bootcamps, and hands-on execution.

---

## Four Core Pillars

1. **Incubation**: Providing mentorship, funding guidance, and resources to help student startups grow from idea to launch. Nurturing early-stage student startup ideas with mentorship, funding guidance, and a supportive incubation ecosystem to transform concepts into viable ventures and real businesses in college.
2. **Innovation**: Driving creative problem-solving through hackathons, coding competitions, and innovation challenges. Fostering a culture of creativity and experimentation through hackathons, coding competitions, tech fests, innovation labs, and hands-on problem-solving workshops for students.
3. **Leadership**: Developing team management, communication, and community-building skills in student leaders. Developing future student leaders through hands-on experience, team management, community building, and real-world project execution at CSMU.
4. **National Reach**: Competing at NEC IIT Bombay and other national platforms, building industry partnerships that put CSMU on the national map. Top 23 at NEC, IIT Bombay out of 4,000+ teams. Connecting with India's national startup ecosystem through premier entrepreneurship competitions, industry partnerships, and innovation challenges.

---

## History & Timeline

1. **Dec 2024 — IIEC Founded**: IIEC (Incubation, Innovation & Entrepreneurship Cell) was established in December 2024 at Chhatrapati Shivaji Maharaj University, Navi Mumbai, to foster startup culture on campus. A group of passionate students recognized the need for an entrepreneurship platform at CSMU. IIEC was born with a vision to build startup culture from the ground up.
2. **Dec 2024–2025 — Building Foundations**: Period of building the entrepreneurship community, organizing workshops, bootcamps, speaker sessions, and internal events to develop the startup ecosystem at CSMU. IIEC grew steadily — organizing events, workshops, and building a strong entrepreneurial community on campus.
3. **2025 — NEC Top 23**: IIEC competed at the National Entrepreneurship Challenge (NEC) by E-Cell IIT Bombay and ranked Top 23 out of 4,000+ teams across India, reaching the NEC Finals. This became the cell's biggest milestone and put CSMU on the national map. Achieved Top 23 rank out of 4,000+ teams at the National Entrepreneurship Challenge (NEC) by E-Cell, IIT Bombay — qualifying for the national finals.
4. **2025–2026 — Expansion & Incubation**: IIEC expanded its scope with incubation support, national outreach, and industry collaborations including GeeksforGeeks.
5. **February 2026 — GENESIS & Beyond**: IIEC held its grand orientation program "GENESIS" on 11 February 2026 in collaboration with GeeksforGeeks at G.D. Badaya Auditorium, CSMU Campus. This marked the beginning of a new chapter with upcoming events like TechAstra, IPL Auction, Problem Auction, and the next NEC journey. Successfully conducted GENESIS — flagship orientation event. Building the team, hosting events, and scaling national presence.

## Flagship Events (Detailed)

### 1. GENESIS — Grand Orientation Program
- **Status**: Successfully Completed
- **Date**: 11 February 2026 (Wednesday)
- **Time**: 10:00 AM Onwards
- **Duration**: 2–3 Hours
- **Venue**: G.D. Badaya Auditorium, CSMU Campus, Navi Mumbai
- **Seating**: Limited — based on auditorium capacity
- **Entry**: Free (isAccessibleForFree: true)
- **Collaboration**: GeeksforGeeks (GfG)
- **Description**: The official orientation program of IIEC. Serves as the entry point for students across all departments who want to explore innovation, entrepreneurship, startup development, and skill building. Introduced IIEC's vision, team structure, upcoming initiatives (TechAstra, NEC), and startup opportunities. Whether you want to build a tech startup, develop coding skills, learn digital marketing, or contribute to campus growth — GENESIS is where the entrepreneurial journey begins.
- **5 Reasons to Attend**: (1) Understand IIEC's Startup Roadmap and 2026 plans — learn what IIEC does and how you can be part of the startup ecosystem at CSMU, (2) Learn Beyond Classrooms with coding workshops and real-world experiences that go beyond academic curriculum, (3) Real-World Startup Skill Exposure including lean startup thinking, product development, pitch deck building, design thinking, and professional skills essential for every student founder, (4) Know How to Join IIEC across 7 portfolios — understand the recruitment process, team roles, campus entrepreneurship opportunities, and how to apply, (5) GeeksforGeeks Learning Opportunities including exclusive coding courses, data structures & algorithms resources, web development paths, and tech community opportunities through GfG collaboration.
- **5 Student Gains**: (1) Entrepreneurship Mindset — exposure to how entrepreneurs think, plan, and execute ideas, (2) Campus Opportunities — clarity on what's available: events, programs, teams, and projects, (3) Skill Development Paths — understand which skills to build and how to get started, (4) Mentorship & Guidance — learn how to access mentors, learning resources, and community support, (5) Recruitment Information — structured details on IIEC's recruitment process and team positions.
- **Event Completion Notice**: GENESIS was successfully conducted on 11 February 2026 at the G.D. Badaya Auditorium, CSMU Campus. Registration for this event is now closed. Stay connected with IIEC for future events and opportunities.

### 2. TechAstra — Annual Technical Fest
- **Status**: Upcoming (Volunteer Registrations Open)
- **Year**: 2026 — Date TBA
- **Location**: CSMU Campus, Navi Mumbai
- **Duration**: 2 Epic Days
- **Expected Footfall**: 1000+ attendees
- **Events**: 10+ events planned
- **Prize Pool**: TBA
- **Organizer**: IIEC
- **Description**: The largest annual technical fest of Chhatrapati Shivaji Maharaj University (CSMU), Navi Mumbai — a celebration of technology, innovation, startup culture, and creativity. From hackathons and coding battles to robotics, AI/ML workshops, tech quizzes, and gaming tournaments — TechAstra brings together the brightest student minds on campus for one power-packed festival of technology and entrepreneurship. Organized by IIEC (Incubation, Innovation & Entrepreneurship Cell), TechAstra is designed to push boundaries, spark startup ideas, develop technical skills, and give students a platform to showcase their brilliance in coding, development, design, and innovation.
- **6 Event Tracks**: (1) Hackathons & Coding Competitions — build, code, and compete in intense coding challenges, hackathons, and programming battles with real-world problem statements and industry mentors, (2) Tech Workshops & Bootcamps — hands-on workshops and bootcamps on AI/ML, web development, Python programming, cybersecurity, cloud computing, and emerging technologies led by industry experts, (3) Innovation & Project Showcase — present tech projects, startup prototypes, and innovations to a panel of industry judges, mentors, and peers; win prizes and get noticed, (4) Tech Quiz & Knowledge Battle — test your knowledge in fast-paced tech quizzes covering data structures, algorithms, CS fundamentals, current tech trends, and more, (5) Gaming Arena & E-Sports — competitive gaming tournaments, e-sports battles, and virtual challenges; show off your reflexes, strategy, and team coordination, (6) & Much More — surprise events, guest speaker sessions, networking opportunities, startup exhibitions, and much more to be announced.
- **8 Volunteer Roles**: Event Management, Technical Support, Registration Desk, Design & Creatives, Social Media & Content, Logistics & Venue, Photography & Videography, Sponsorship & Outreach.
- **Volunteer Registration Form Fields**: Full Name (required), Department (required), Academic Year (required — First Year/Second Year/Third Year/Final Year), College Roll Number (required), Mobile Number (required — 10-digit), Email Address (required), Preferred Volunteer Roles (required — checkboxes from 8 roles), Your Key Skills (optional), Why do you want to volunteer? (optional), Any Previous Event Experience? (optional), Consent checkbox (required).
- **Why Volunteer**: (1) Leadership & Team Management Experience — take ownership of real tech events, manage cross-functional teams, and build leadership skills that matter for your career beyond the classroom, (2) Networking — connect with like-minded peers, tech enthusiasts, seniors, and industry professionals, (3) Certificate & Recognition — get an official volunteer certificate from IIEC and recognition for your contribution.
- **Post-Submission Flow**: After form submission, volunteers see a success screen with 3 action items: (1) Check inbox for confirmation email (also check spam/junk), (2) Join the Volunteer WhatsApp Group for all updates, tasks & coordination, (3) Follow on Instagram for announcements, reveals & behind-the-scenes.
- **TechAstra Instagram**: https://www.instagram.com/techastra.csmu
- **Volunteer WhatsApp Group**: https://chat.whatsapp.com/LKfRXSRsxfmFho4sQ8XhwF
- **Full TechAstra Website**: Under construction — dedicated website with event details, schedules, registrations, and more coming soon.

### 3. IPL Auction
- **Status**: Coming Soon (2026)
- **Description**: Experience entrepreneurship through sports management and strategic thinking. A simulated IPL auction event where students strategize, bid, and build their dream team, developing entrepreneurial skills through cricket-themed auction dynamics, team-building, and strategic decision-making.

### 4. Problem Auction
- **Status**: Coming Soon (2026)
- **Description**: Bid on real-world problems and develop innovative solutions using design thinking and lean startup methodology. A unique competitive event where teams bid on actual problem statements from industry partners and compete to develop the most innovative, scalable startup solutions.

### 5. National Entrepreneurship Challenge (NEC) Journey
- **Status**: Coming Soon (2026)
- **Organizer**: E-Cell IIT Bombay
- **Description**: Begin the NEC journey — represent CSMU on the national stage and compete with the brightest entrepreneurial minds across India. NEC is India's largest inter-college entrepreneurship competition. IIEC previously ranked Top 23 out of 4,000+ teams and reached the NEC Finals at IIT Bombay.

---

## Regular Programs

1. **Skill Development Workshops**: Weekly hands-on workshops covering essential startup and technical skills — pitch deck design, financial modeling, product development, digital marketing strategies, web development, AI/ML, Python programming, data structures, and more.

2. **Ideation & Brainstorming Sessions**: Bi-weekly design thinking and brainstorming sessions where students pitch innovative startup ideas, receive mentorship feedback, explore business model canvas frameworks, practice customer development, and form teams to work on promising business concepts.

3. **Mentorship & Industry Connect**: Connect with industry mentors, angel investors, startup founders, and venture capital professionals for guidance on the entrepreneurial journey. Get paired with experienced professionals in relevant domains for ongoing mentorship.

4. **Startup Bootcamps & Hackathons**: Intensive programs that take students from ideation to prototype, covering lean startup methodology, MVP development, market validation, and pitch preparation.

5. **Speaker Series & Guest Lectures**: Sessions featuring entrepreneurs, industry professionals, and subject matter experts sharing insights on building startups, technology trends, and career growth.

---

## What IIEC Offers

1. **Workshops & Startup Bootcamps**: Intensive training sessions covering business planning, product development, pitch deck design, financial modeling, marketing strategies, and the essential skills every student founder needs to succeed.
2. **Mentorship & Industry Network**: Access to a growing network of entrepreneurs, angel investors, industry experts, and experienced mentors who provide real guidance on the college startup journey.
3. **Startup Launchpad**: From ideation to launch — resources, venture capital connections, national-level exposure through NEC IIT Bombay, and end-to-end incubation support to turn student startup visions into reality.

### History of Growth Timeline
From a student initiative to a nationally recognized entrepreneurship powerhouse.

1. **Dec 2024 — IIEC Launch**: Founded as IIEC — a passionate student-led initiative to foster entrepreneurial mindset and build startup culture within the university.
2. **2025 — NEC — Top 23 All India**: Ranked Top 23 out of 4,000+ teams at the National Entrepreneurship Challenge (NEC) by E-Cell, IIT Bombay. Made it to the national finals, earning recognition among the best in the country.
3. **2025–2026 — Expansion & Incubation**: Expanded scope with incubation support, national outreach, and industry collaborations including GeeksforGeeks. [Current]

### Core Pillars
The four foundations that drive our mission forward.

1. **Incubation (01)**: Nurturing early-stage student startup ideas with mentorship, funding guidance, and a supportive incubation ecosystem to transform concepts into viable ventures and real businesses in college.
2. **Innovation (02)**: Fostering a culture of creativity and experimentation through hackathons, coding competitions, tech fests, innovation labs, and hands-on problem-solving workshops for students.
3. **Leadership (03)**: Developing future student leaders through hands-on experience, team management, community building, and real-world project execution at CSMU.
4. **National Reach (04)**: Competing at the highest level — Top 23 at NEC, IIT Bombay out of 4,000+ teams. Connecting with India's national startup ecosystem through premier entrepreneurship competitions, industry partnerships, and innovation challenges.

### What We Offer
Comprehensive support for every stage of your entrepreneurial journey.

1. **Workshops & Startup Bootcamps**: Intensive training sessions covering business planning, product development, pitch deck design, financial modeling, marketing strategies, and the essential skills every student founder needs to succeed.
2. **Mentorship & Industry Network**: Access to a growing network of entrepreneurs, angel investors, industry experts, and experienced mentors who provide real guidance on your college startup journey.
3. **Startup Launchpad**: From ideation to launch — resources, venture capital connections, national-level exposure through NEC IIT Bombay, and end-to-end incubation support to turn your student startup vision into reality.

## Full Page Content: About (about.html)

**URL**: https://iiec.in/about.html
**Title**: About | IIEC
**Meta Description**: About IIEC - Incubation, Innovation & Entrepreneurship Cell at CSMU, Navi Mumbai. Our mission, vision, and journey building Maharashtra's leading student entrepreneurship ecosystem. Top 23 at NEC IIT Bombay. Where Vision Drives Venture.
**Canonical**: https://iiec.in/about

### Page Header
About IIEC — Our mission, vision, and the journey ahead

### Who We Are
IIEC — Incubation, Innovation & Entrepreneurship Cell is the official student-led entrepreneurship hub of Chhatrapati Shivaji Maharaj University, Navi Mumbai. What started as a small group of passionate students at IIEC has grown into a nationally recognized movement — ranked Top 23 out of 4,000+ teams across India at the National Entrepreneurship Challenge (NEC) by E-Cell, IIT Bombay. We are one of the best entrepreneurship cells in Maharashtra.

We exist to bridge the gap between ideas and execution. Through skill development workshops, startup mentorship, national competitions, hackathons, coding bootcamps, and industry connections, IIEC provides the platform where raw ambition transforms into real ventures. We don't just study entrepreneurship — we practice it. From business plan competitions to startup incubation, our community of student founders is building the future.

Every member who joins IIEC becomes part of a legacy of innovation and entrepreneurship. We're building a culture where innovation is second nature, failures are celebrated as lessons, and every student at CSMU is empowered to think like a startup founder and leader.

- Top 23 — NEC All India Rank
- 4,000+ — Teams Competed Against

### Our Mission
To ignite the entrepreneurial spirit in every student at Chhatrapati Shivaji Maharaj University by providing hands-on startup experiences, real-world industry exposure, and a community that turns bold ideas into impactful ventures.

Mission Points:
- Foster innovation, design thinking, and creative problem-solving
- Compete and excel at national-level entrepreneurship challenges like NEC IIT Bombay
- Connect students with industry leaders, angel investors, and mentors
- Build a launchpad for student-led startups and innovation projects

### Our Vision
To establish IIEC as India's most recognized college entrepreneurship cell that produces successful student founders, award-winning teams, and a self-sustaining innovation ecosystem at CSMU, Navi Mumbai.

Vision Points:
- Grow a thriving community of student entrepreneurs and innovators
- Incubate and launch student-led startups from CSMU campus
- Achieve excellence at national competitions like NEC IIT Bombay and beyond
- Build strategic partnerships with industry, incubators, and venture capital firms

### Our Journey (Timeline)
Milestones we've achieved and the road ahead.

1. **Dec 2024 — IIEC Founded**: A group of passionate students recognized the need for an entrepreneurship platform at CSMU. IIEC was born with a vision to build startup culture from the ground up.
2. **Dec 2024–2025 — Building Foundations**: IIEC grew steadily — organizing events, workshops, and building a strong entrepreneurial community on campus.
3. **2025 — NEC — Top 23 All India**: Achieved Top 23 rank out of 4,000+ teams at the National Entrepreneurship Challenge (NEC) by E-Cell, IIT Bombay — qualifying for the national finals and putting CSMU on the map. [Milestone]
4. **2025–2026 — Expansion & Incubation**: IIEC expanded scope to cover incubation, innovation labs, and national outreach.
5. **Feb 2026 — GENESIS & Beyond**: Successfully conducted GENESIS — our flagship orientation event in collaboration with GeeksforGeeks. Building the team, hosting events, and scaling our national presence. [Completed]

### Our Values
The principles that guide everything we do.

1. **Innovation First**: We encourage thinking differently, challenging norms, and finding creative startup solutions to real-world problems through design thinking and lean methodology.
2. **Community Driven**: Success is collective. Our student founder network builds each other up, shares knowledge through peer learning, and celebrates every startup milestone together.
3. **Action Oriented**: Ideas are great, execution is everything. We believe in learning by doing — through hackathons, startup bootcamps, and real project building — and failing forward fast.

### Continue Exploring
1. GENESIS — The Beginning of Innovation [Event Completed] — Our flagship orientation event in collaboration with GeeksforGeeks — successfully held on 11 Feb 2026.
2. Meet the Team [Our People] — The people behind the mission — leadership, core team, and every portfolio head.
3. Activities & Events [What's Coming] — Upcoming events, workshops, and programs — there's always something happening at IIEC.

  - Date: 11 February 2026

### What is GENESIS
GENESIS is the official orientation program of IIEC — the Incubation, Innovation & Entrepreneurship Cell at Chhatrapati Shivaji Maharaj University, Navi Mumbai. It serves as the entry point for students across all departments who want to explore innovation, entrepreneurship, startup development, and skill building beyond the traditional classroom.

The event introduces IIEC's vision, team structure, upcoming initiatives like TechAstra and NEC IIT Bombay, and the startup opportunities available for every student. Whether you want to build a tech startup, develop coding skills, learn digital marketing, or contribute to campus growth — GENESIS is where your entrepreneurial journey begins.

In collaboration with GeeksforGeeks — bringing additional learning resources and technical opportunities to attendees.

### Why Attend GENESIS
What you take away from this event:

1. **Understand IIEC's Startup Roadmap**: Learn what IIEC does, its innovation and entrepreneurship plans for 2026, and how you can be part of the startup ecosystem at CSMU.
2. **Learn Beyond Classrooms**: Discover startup skills, coding workshops, and real-world experiences that go beyond your academic curriculum and prepare you for the industry.
3. **Real-World Startup Skill Exposure**: Get introduced to lean startup thinking, product development, pitch deck building, design thinking, and professional skills essential for every student founder.
4. **Know How to Join IIEC**: Understand the recruitment process, team roles across 7 portfolios, campus entrepreneurship opportunities, and how to apply to be part of the innovation cell.
5. **GeeksforGeeks Learning Opportunities**: Access exclusive coding courses, data structures & algorithms resources, web development paths, and tech community opportunities through GfG collaboration.

### Event Details
- Date: 11 February 2026 (Wednesday)
- Time: 10:00 AM Onwards
- Duration: 2 – 3 Hours
- Venue: G.D. Badaya Auditorium, CSMU Campus
- Seating: Limited — based on auditorium capacity
- Status: Successfully Completed

### What You'll Gain
The value you walk away with after GENESIS:

1. **Entrepreneurship Mindset (01)**: Exposure to how entrepreneurs think, plan, and execute ideas.
2. **Campus Opportunities (02)**: Clarity on what's available — events, programs, teams, and projects.
3. **Skill Development Paths (03)**: Understand which skills to build and how to get started.
4. **Mentorship & Guidance (04)**: Learn how to access mentors, learning resources, and community support.
5. **Recruitment Information (05)**: Structured details on IIEC's recruitment process and team positions.

### What is TechAstra?
TechAstra is the largest annual technical fest of Chhatrapati Shivaji Maharaj University (CSMU), Navi Mumbai — a celebration of technology, innovation, startup culture, and creativity. From hackathons and coding battles to robotics, AI/ML workshops, tech quizzes, and gaming tournaments — TechAstra brings together the brightest student minds on campus for one power-packed festival of technology and entrepreneurship.

Organized by IIEC (Incubation, Innovation & Entrepreneurship Cell), TechAstra is designed to push boundaries, spark startup ideas, develop technical skills, and give students a platform to showcase their brilliance in coding, development, design, and innovation.

This year, we're going bigger than ever. And we need YOU to make it happen.

### Event Tracks
Here's a glimpse of what's being planned:

1. **Hackathons & Coding Competitions** [Competitions]: Build, code, and compete in intense coding challenges, hackathons, and programming battles with real-world problem statements and industry mentors.
2. **Tech Workshops & Bootcamps** [Learning]: Hands-on workshops and bootcamps on AI/ML, web development, Python programming, cybersecurity, cloud computing, and emerging technologies led by industry experts.
3. **Innovation & Project Showcase** [Exhibition]: Present your tech projects, startup prototypes, and innovations to a panel of industry judges, mentors, and peers. Win prizes and get noticed.
4. **Tech Quiz & Knowledge Battle** [Brain Battle]: Test your knowledge in fast-paced tech quizzes covering data structures, algorithms, CS fundamentals, current tech trends, and more.
5. **Gaming Arena & E-Sports** [E-Sports]: Competitive gaming tournaments, e-sports battles, and virtual challenges — show off your reflexes, strategy, and team coordination.
6. **& Much More...** [Stay Tuned]: Surprise events, guest speaker sessions, networking opportunities, startup exhibitions, and much more to be announced! Follow IIEC on social media for updates.

### Why Volunteer?
Be the backbone of the biggest tech fest on campus.

1. **Leadership & Team Management Experience**: Take ownership of real tech events, manage cross-functional teams, and build leadership skills that matter for your career beyond the classroom.
2. **Networking**: Connect with like-minded peers, tech enthusiasts, seniors, and industry professionals.
3. **Certificate & Recognition**: Get an official volunteer certificate from IIEC and recognition for your contribution.

## Accessibility Features

- ARIA roles on navigation (role="navigation"), menu items (role="menuitem"), and content sections
- ARIA labels on all interactive elements (buttons, links, forms)
- ARIA landmarks: main navigation, footer (role="contentinfo"), sections with aria-labelledby
- Skip to main content link (team.html)
- Alt text on all images
- Semantic HTML structure (header, nav, main, section, article, footer)
- Form labels with required field indicators
- Focus management and keyboard navigation support
- High contrast text on dark backgrounds
- Responsive design with viewport meta tag (maximum-scale=5.0)

---

## Performance & Optimization

- WebP image format throughout for optimized loading
- Lazy loading on below-fold images (loading="lazy")
- Eager loading on critical images like logos (loading="eager")
- Async decoding on images (decoding="async")
- Preconnect to Google Fonts
- Deferred JavaScript loading (defer attribute)
- CSS split into page-specific files to reduce unused CSS
- Minimal external dependencies (no CSS/JS frameworks)
- Static site on GitHub Pages CDN

## Upcoming & Flagship Events in Detail

### 1. IPL Auction 2026
- **Date:** 22 April 2026
- **Venue:** Seminar Hall, Pratapgad Block, CSMU Campus
- **Theme:** "Bid like a captain"
- **Dress Code:** Team colors + sporty
- **Format:** 5 Rounds held throughout the year, culminating in 1 Grand Finale. Winners and Runners-up from each round advance to the finale.
- **Scale:** 10 IPL franchise teams competing for 1 Grand winning squad
- **Description:** A live auction arena where participants' decisions shape a dream squad. It tests strategy, budget management, and bidding tactics under pressure. Participants scout for players, bid within budgets, and build a winning team.
- **Status:** Registrations Closed (as per the latest update).
- **URL:** https://iiec.in/ipl-auction.html

### 2. TechAstra 2026: The Multiverse of Innovation
- **Title:** The Largest Annual Technical Fest of Chhatrapati Shivaji Maharaj University
- **Organized By:** IIEC - Incubation, Innovation & Entrepreneurship Cell
- **Dates:** March 17-18, 2026
- **Scale & Prizes:** 15 Events, 1000+ Expected Footfall, ₹50K+ Total Prize Pool
- **URL:** https://iiec.in/techastra.html

**Flagship Events & Competitions included in TechAstra:**
- **CEOs Talk:** Featuring IIT Bombay alumni founders Anup Raj and Aman Goel (March 18, 2026).
- **Guardians of Governance (Tech MUN):** The official Model United Nations conference debating AI regulation, cybersecurity, and digital privacy across 6 committees.
- **Webathon:** A 3-4 hour intensive web development hackathon where teams build web apps live.
- **Stark Expo / Project Exhibition:** A live showcase of innovative tech projects presented to expert judges.
- **N8N Automation Workshop:** A 2-Day intensive workshop on no-code automation and building workflows in collaboration with NCP.
- **Infinity Stones Hunt:** A thrilling campus-wide treasure hunt featuring complex puzzles and clues.
- **E-Sports & Gaming Tournaments:** Highly competitive brackets for Valorant (5v5), BGMI (Squad), and FreeFire (Squad).
- **Other Competitions:** Chess Tournament (1v1 strategic matchups) and Reel Craft Competition (short-form video creation).
- **Volunteering:** Roles included Event Management, Technical Support, Design & Creatives, Logistics, Sponsorship, Photography, and Social Media.
